steps.title: Welcome to Leather Crafting
steps.prompt: Watch the complete course introduction.
steps.check: I can see the raised form
steps.say: Welcome to Leather Crafting. A flat piece of vegetable-tanned leather can become a portrait full of character. When damp, leather softens and can be shaped. As it dries, it holds its form. You will learn to work with that change, then add texture, color, and a careful finish.

steps.title: Shape. Carve. Color. Finish.
steps.prompt: Four moves turn a flat sheet into a finished piece.
steps.say: Across all three projects, we will return to four basic processes. First, shape damp leather into a raised form. Next, carve the details and texture. Then build color in light layers. Finally, finish the edges, stitching, and hardware. These four moves take a flat sheet of leather all the way to a finished piece.

steps.title: One eye. Two portraits.
steps.prompt: Tap each project to explore your path.
steps.say: Our three projects follow one clear path. First, make an eye: shape the gaze, finish its edges, and stitch a small piece. Next, make a cat: outline its features, carve the form and fur, add color, and build a frame. Finally, make a dog: prepare the photograph, trace and emboss the design, then shape, color, and frame it. We will learn the eye first, then the cat, then the dog.
